description.narrative: The Energy Transition Roadmap is an objective, fact-based roadmap for delivery pathways that can ensure a thriving, sustainable energy future. The ETR objectively frames key trade-offs between systems in terms of enablers required and system benefit, and is an assessment of the critical initiatives needed through to 2034 to drive implementation.

title.narrative: Energy Council - South African Energy Transition Roadmap

description.narrative: - Overview of the Energy Council of South Africa - Context of the South African Power Sector - Introduction to the Energy Transition Roadmap - Strategic Framework for the Energy Transition Roadmap - Strategic Toolkits - Energy Transition Roadmap Initiatives - Appendix Modelling Methodology; Model Inputs & Assumptions; Detailed Model Results; Response to Questions from DMRE on Model Results; Unabridged Integrated System Definition Toolkit; Unabridged Emissions Reduction Toolkit; Unabridged Coal Toolkit; Unabridged Gas-to-Power Toolkit; Unabridged Renewables & Storage Toolkit; Unabridged Market Reform Toolkit; Literature Review
